zh-CN.title: 广场搜索与提醒，更清晰
items: 统一顶部工具图标，搜索改为模态框并支持开始、结束日期筛选
互动额度区分近24小时与近7天用量，展示实际可用次数
统一广场消息与导航角标，修复新发言红点被清除或放大的问题

en.title: Clearer Square search and notifications
items: Consistent toolbar icons and a dedicated search dialog with optional start and end dates
Interaction quota shows both rolling windows and the actual remaining allowance
Consistent notification badges with stable new-post indicators
